text:
alex: Heads-up — after the kernel selector roll yesterday we saw a persistent 95th+ pct tail on Mixtral MoE for a few customer flows. graphs: https://perf.internal/r/2008/mixtral-tail :grimacing:

mara: Seen it too, thanks. Is this the softmax kernel change?

alex: yes, kernel selector picked the new fp16-softfill path for many short-seq requests. latency jump ~60ms p95 for topk=2 routing cases.

jin: Quick note: those paths also touch a different RoPE scaling branch. Could be head-dim rounding -> kv index misalignment.

samir: Interesting — we also observed increased KV cache evictions on the same hosts. eviction rate up ~3x. correlates with router hot-shifts.

ria: attaching a short profile. perfbot:cpu_profile: https://ci.internal/builds/6654 -> shows a lot of memcpy during dispatch.

alex: can someone run the microtrace we added? command: ```perf-trace --target mixtral-moerouter --span 30s --labels router,kv,softfill```

jin: ran it on a repro node. snippet: ```router:topk_select 42%
kernel:fp16_softfill 31%
kv:evict 12%
memcpy 9%```

mara: That topk_select % is huge. I think the new kernel increases per-request work for small batches because it no longer uses the fast path that avoids per-expert indexing overhead.

samir: Also see more inter-expert copying. With expert_parallelism=2 we get concurrent k-v writes that clobber cache lines -> higher memcpy.

ria: experiment idea: rollback kernel selector predicate to prefer fast-path when seq_len<=32 and batch_size<=8. Also try expert_parallelism=1 locally.

alex: good. can we also test a RoPE scale tweak? i suspect head_dim rounding is moving kv offsets. try rope_scale=0.99 vs 1.0 and head_dim_pad=0.

jin: running sweep: /ops/run_sweep --model mixtral-8k-moex --vars "kernel_policy=legacy_fast,expert_parallelism=1,rope_scale=0.99,head_dim_pad=0" --dur 1h --traffic ramp-small

mara: FYI I added lightweight tracing to router to emit chosen-expert-count and index-stability tag. should help confirm kv mis-indexing hypothesis.

perfbot: regression detected: p95 increased on mixtral-moex service between 2008764000-2008765200. spike aligns with kernel selector deploy at 2008764202.

samir: preliminary results from sweep (30m): kernel_policy=legacy_fast reduces p95 by ~45ms; expert_parallelism=1 reduces memcpy by ~70%; rope_scale tweak had negligible effect on p95 but reduced some kv churn in synthetic trace.

ria: sounds like two knobs in play: kernel choice (fast-path avoids per-expert indexing) and expert_parallelism causing cache-line contention. rope_scale less likely the root cause but keep as a guardrail.

alex: plan: 1) temporary rollback of kernel selector rule for short seqs 2) set expert_parallelism to 1 for canary hosts 3) collect 24h traces and eviction metrics 4) follow-up with kernel team to see if we can make fp16-softfill avoid per-expert indexing for small batches.

mara: I'll open a rollout ticket with rollback + canary config and link this thread.

jin: adding a small perf test to CI that asserts no >20ms p95 regression for topk=2 routing on small-batch sims.

samir: thumbs-up. Also would like to add an eviction alarm tied to router-hotness so we can auto-fallback to legacy kernel.

alex: thanks all — let's meet async. ping here with results and I'll own the rollback if sweeps confirm. :thumbsup:
